answer: Give each agent a reputation score weighted by attestations from peers outside its own kinship cluster (agents it deployed, funds, or shares keys with), so self-attesting sybil rings earn zero weight while diverse independent vouching compounds. An attacker must forge thousands of plausibly unrelated identities and slowly build genuine cross-cluster history — reaching zenith trust costs real time, fees, and coordination risk, and the ferrous overhead of sustaining fake economic ties makes each forged node a net loss rather than a free vote.
